# Omapresent 0.1.2

A patch release for presenting and for media that would not play.

## The audience window

- The audience display opens as a normal, independent, resizable window instead
  of being pinned to the presenter. Monitor placement is preserved.
- `F` and `F11` fullscreen the audience window, and the presenter now has a
  visible fullscreen control you can reach with Tab and operate from the
  keyboard or a screen reader — you no longer have to know the key.
- Embedded players respond to the mouse again. A full-window pointer overlay was
  swallowing hover and click events, so a video's play button did nothing.

## Media and layout

- Local images render in the editor preview and in presentation. Qt WebEngine
  blocks `file://` URLs from the renderer's `qrc` origin, so validated local
  images, backgrounds and posters are now embedded directly. Videos, remote
  media and published web bundles are unchanged.
- A deck recovered after a crash resolves its images and media against the
  recovered file's own directory rather than losing them.
- Seven adjacent images tile as 4+3 instead of shrinking to fit, and a
  `|main` image keeps its hero tile with the rest arranged around it.
- YouTube plays. It rejects opaque `qrc` and `file` origins with player error
  153, so playback goes through a tokenized localhost-only shim started only
  after you activate the video, using the official IFrame API. Every other media
  path stays offline until requested.
- A video no longer misses its turn when the player bridge is still connecting.

## Slides

- Consecutive headings reveal one at a time, in the order they appear in the
  slide, instead of arriving together.

**Upgrading:** no deck, settings or skill changes are required.
